_legend.verified: Feed returned live jobs when queried from here, and the jobs belong to this company
_legend.identified: ATS and board found through indexed job URLs, but the feed was not queried (network blocked). Must be checked before scraping
_legend.unconfirmed: ATS not established; evidence is weak or contradictory
_legend.no_feed: No machine-readable public job feed (email, static page, aggregators only, or 0 openings)
